description:
Activate Arixmethes by tapping it, adding {G}{U}
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Arixmethes.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Arixmethes.
Repeat.

uses.name: Arixmethes, Slumbering Isle
uses.cardState: without a slumber counter on it
